title: private-deploy-field-notes-rashid-khan
content:
Field notes / scratchpad for ACME Corp private deployment (on-prem w/ VPC-like network). Quick log of install steps, gotchas, customer env reminders and current blockers. Informal notes - meant for on-site triage and handoff.

Summary:
- Customer environment: strict outbound egress (no internet), internal PKI, corporate proxy for apt/yum, Azure AD for service accounts (SSO), no public IPs except via bastion.
- Target infra: k8s 1.26 (RKE2), 3 node control plane (air-gapped), GPU node pool with A100s, NFS for shared model artifacts, S3-compatible on-prem object store (MinIO) with internal DNS svc.

Preflight checklist (done/remaining):
- [x] Confirmed kernel & nvidia drivers on GPU nodes (470.x) - driver mismatch fixed on node-3 (rebooted).
- [x] CRI/containerd version aligned (containerd 1.6.x) - had to drop cgroup v2 -> set cgroupfs for runtime.
- [ ] ECR / registry access: customer uses private registry behind proxy - need credentials + certs. (Blocker: registry cert not in cluster truststore)
- [x] Internal CA certs provided (installed on nodes and control plane).
- [ ] KMS/HSM integration: customer uses on-prem HSM; need key alias & endpoint - waiting on security to share role mapping.
- [x] DNS entries for control-plane and minio created in internal DNS (minio.acme.internal).

Install steps (notes / commands used):
- Helm chart values: set image.pullPolicy: IfNotPresent, registry: "internal-reg.acme.local", imagePullSecrets: "acme-reg-secret".
- K8s: label gpu nodes -> kubectl label node gpu-node-1 redwood/gpu=true.
- NVidia: used nvidia-driver-installer.sh from ops repo; verified nvidia-smi after reboot.
- Runtime: deployed redwood-runtime helm chart with --set storage.s3.endpoint=minio.acme.internal --set network.proxy.url=http://proxy.acme.internal:3128
- Certs: placed intermediate CA at /etc/ssl/certs/acme-intermediate.crt and restarted kubelet.

Blockers & open questions:
1) Registry cert not trusted by nodes -> operations to install CA chain or provide cert-rotated images. Customer says their registry uses wildcard cert signed by internal CA. Need ops to push or add CA.
2) HSM/KMS integration: security needs to confirm allowed API ranges and service principal mapping for the HSM. Without this, secrets encryption path cannot be completed; fallback is local KMS but customer policy forbids.
3) No outbound to github.com: some helm charts attempt to pull remote CRDs on install -> must vendor CRDs into chart tarball. I built a local chart archive but CI needs to adopt.
4) GPU kernel param mismatch on node-2 (OOM killer observed during small load test) - set vm.overcommit_memory=1 and earlyoom disabled, retest.

Quick reminders for on-call / next on-site runbook:
- Bring USB with offline chart tarballs (runtime, runtime-operator, metrics) and minio credentials.
- Steps to verify runtime after deploy: curl --unix-socket /var/run/redwood.sock -H "Host: runtime" '/healthz' (or check pod logs: runtime-controller).
- If function-calls hang: check envoy sidecar logs on inference pods and confirm TTL settings on internal LB.
- For KMS errors: check /var/log/redwood/kms-client.log for 403 vs network timeouts. 403 implies principal mapping issue; timeout implies NAT/proxy block.

Hand-off notes for Maya / Samira:
- Maya: follow up on registry cert install (ops ticket JIRA-PD-452). If ops can install CA on nodes, we can proceed with image pull test.
- Samira: coordinate with security on HSM role mapping and provide test credentials. If delayed > 3 days, plan fallback dry-run with local KMS and document deviations.

Links / references to bring to customer meeting:
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-PRIVATE-DEPLOY-045 (installation checklist + vendor notes)
- PR with vendored CRDs: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/789
- Jira: JIRA-PD-452 (registry cert / image pull failures)

Notes to self / quick TODOs:
- Add minio lifecycle policy for model blobs (TTL 90d) once object lifecycle allowed.
- Add check to preflight script to detect remote-CRD references in charts (script snippet in ops repo).
- Document kernel param changes we made on node-2 in node-runbook.md (so SRE doesn't revert).

Rough timeline estimate (if blockers resolved):
- Day 0: preflight + CA install + vendored charts deployed
- Day 1: runtime helm deploy + model sync to minio + smoke tests (latency/basic generation)
- Day 2: load test (batching + KV cache validation) + handoff to customer devs

Anything else I forgot? jot here during next call.

-- Rashid K. (on-site notes)
